drhp.business: Nureca operates in the Indian home-healthcare space, addressing demand for preventive healthcare, home diagnostics and wellness solutions. The Company reaches consumers through digital and quick commerce platforms alongside an expanding digital ecosystem, and describes its manufacturing capabilities as strengthened during the year. Its broader mission, as stated in the governance report, is to alleviate human suffering by delivering globally competitive, high-quality and affordable healthcare solutions.
drhp.end_markets: India — home healthcare / preventive healthcare, home diagnostics and wellness consumers|Digital marketplaces and quick commerce channels|Domestic and international markets (regulatory compliance referenced across both)
drhp.expansion: Nureca's principal expansion project is an upcoming manufacturing facility at Sundran, Punjab, described by the Chairman as one of the most important investments in the Company's history. It is being developed as a modern healthcare manufacturing platform spanning medical devices, consumables, hygiene products and allied categories, and is framed not merely as production capacity but as an integrated capability set covering product engineering, process control, automation, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, vendor development and continuous improvement. sk.overview: The DRHP frames the sector using the commissioned '1Lattice Report' (Molecular Diagnostics Industry Report dated July 24, 2026). Diagnostics is positioned as the cornerstone of India's healthcare sector, split into in vitro diagnostics (pathology tests on samples) and in vivo diagnostics (radiology). Within IVD, molecular diagnostics analyses nucleic acids (DNA/RNA) via PCR, isothermal amplification, nucleic acid hybridisation and microarrays to detect infectious disease, oncology and genetic conditions.
